answer: A juror that skips cases loses 6% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. Because the garden decay is applied at each close, the meadow audit publishes the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool therefore watches its influence decay while paying the jade fee to keep them eligible. Honest users pay that once, farms 37 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
